01 — Just for you

My
Baby,

♡

I

don't think I have ever found the right number of words for what you mean to me. So instead of trying to make this perfect, I wanted to make it personal — a little place where I can put all the things I probably don't say enough.

You have this way of making ordinary moments feel different. A random conversation becomes something I remember. A simple smile stays in my head longer than it should. Even the smallest things about you somehow become my favorite things.

I love your smile. I love your little expressions. I love the way you can be soft one moment and completely impossible the next. I love the silly side of you, the serious side, the quiet side, and all the versions of you in between.

And honestly, I don't just want the pretty moments. I want the random ones too — the sleepy conversations, the nonsense, the little arguments, the “look at this” messages, the unexpected calls, the days when nothing special happens at all. Those are the moments that make you feel close.

When I look at these photographs, I don't just see pictures. I see you. I see little pieces of the person I have grown so attached to, and I feel ridiculously lucky that I get to know this version of you.

I hope this year is gentle with you. I hope you get more reasons to smile, more places to explore, more dreams that come true, and more days where you feel completely loved and appreciated.

And whenever life gets heavy, I hope you remember that you don't have to carry everything perfectly. You can have bad days. You can be tired. You can be confused. You can simply be you. You never have to earn the right to be cared for.

I want to keep collecting just uss with you. More photographs. More adventures. More ridiculous conversations. More memories that make us smile years later. I want the story to keep going, one ordinary and beautiful day at a time.

So yes, this whole website is unnecessarily dramatic. But you are my baby, and apparently that makes me incapable of doing anything halfway.

Happy birthday, my love. Keep smiling that smile, keep being exactly who you are, and please never forget how incredibly special you are to me.

— yours, with all my love ♡
